736:t_1:246.en:
$$クラン$$
「So there must still be some space monsters left after all...」

736:t_1:247.en:
$$カナリア$$
「Even so, now that their nest has been destroyed, their numbers have to be limited.」

736:t_1:248.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Besides, organizations from all over the universe, starting with the $$サイデリアル$$, joined forces to take down the space monsters.」

736:t_1:249.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「The force that seeks to exist... In other words, I can't believe enough of them remain to wipe out the life that lives in the universe...」

736:t_1:250.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Then there might be $$バアル$$ we don't know about...!?」

736:t_1:251.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Then I'll just make them listen to our songs, too.」

736:t_1:253.en:
$$ランカ$$
「But the power of song let us understand each other, even with the $$バジュラ$$.」

736:t_1:254.en:
$$シェリル$$
「Song is feeling... the power of life itself... As long as there is life, we'll keep on singing.」

736:t_1:255.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Yeah! I'll sing until it reaches everything in the universe!」

736:t_1:256.en:
$$レド$$
「$$バサラ$$... If we manage to survive, please go and visit the $$人類銀河同盟$$.」

736:t_1:257.en:
$$レド$$
「I want the people of the Alliance to hear your songs, too.」

736:t_1:259.en:
$$レド$$
「The $$ガルガンティア船団$$ is where I'll live my life.」

736:t_1:261.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「So you're up for running a repair shop with me, then?」

736:t_1:262.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Oh my, $$ピニオン$$... Aren't you going to become a great man who roams every sea with me?」

736:t_1:263.en:
$$ガロード$$
「You're not going to have time for piracy, that's for sure.」

736:t_1:264.en:
$$ロラン$$
「That's right. If we can get through this battle, the world is sure to change a great deal.」

736:t_1:265.en:
$$ガロード$$
「No matter what kind of world it turns into, I'll still be with $$ティファ$$.」

736:t_1:267.en:
$$パーラ$$
「What are you going to do, $$ロラン$$?」

736:t_1:268.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I don't know yet... I'll think it over slowly once I'm back on Earth.」

736:t_1:269.en:
$$ロラン$$
(But if I'm allowed to, there's something I've already decided...)

736:t_1:271.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Exactly. You have grasped the truth and stand at the entrance to $$シンカ$$. What awaits you is a new world: the infinite universe.」

736:t_1:272.en:
$$隼人$$
「I see. If those who can't coexist go out into space, they'll only spread the fighting.」

736:t_1:273.en:
$$弁慶$$
「I'm sick of fighting. If I'm going out into space anyway, I want to make friends with everyone I meet, one after another.」

736:t_1:274.en:
$$タケル$$
「If we have that kind of heart, I'm sure we can live out in space.」

736:t_1:275.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「The territories of the former $$ギシン星$$ realm will surely wish to build friendly relations with the Earth that defeated $$ズール$$.」

736:t_1:276.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「At the very least, the worlds of the Milky Way Galaxy should be grateful for Earth's part in the space monster extermination operation, and hold it in high regard.」

736:t_1:277.en:
$$アキラ$$
「Wait, does that mean Earth is a celebrity!?」

736:t_1:278.en:
$$ナオト$$
「Of course it is. We even drove off the $$サイデリアル$$, after all.」

736:t_1:279.en:
$$ミカ$$
「But you shouldn't act like that.」

736:t_1:280.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「Earth isn't the only one that fought the $$サイデリアル$$ and the space monsters.」

736:t_1:281.en:
$$さやか$$
「Right, that was the result of people from many different stars joining forces.」

736:t_1:282.en:
$$ボス$$
「And not just people. The $$バジュラ$$ and the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ too.」

736:t_1:283.en:
$$ヌケ$$
「So once we go out into space, we'll be getting along with those guys, too.」

736:t_1:284.en:
$$ムチャ$$
「$$ボス$$, since human girls are out of the question for you, why don't we look for a girlfriend from among those guys?」

736:t_1:287.en:
$$渓$$
「What are you saying? You need to be at least that much to survive in the times ahead.」

736:t_1:288.en:
$$葵$$
「But if we're talking about widening our world, I'd like to visit parallel worlds, not just space.」

736:t_1:289.en:
$$朔哉$$
「Are you going to look for a boyfriend over there too, $$葵$$?」

736:t_1:290.en:
$$葵$$
「That's not it, but I want to see my seniors again.」

736:t_1:291.en:
$$くらら$$
「And not just them, but also the people we were separated from by the $$新世時空震動$$.」

736:t_1:292.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「So many dreams open up.」

736:t_1:295.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Heh... Talking about dreams with a battle right in front of you. You guys are awfully laid-back.」

736:t_1:297.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Yeah... Dreams and hope are the power to live. As long as we have them, we can keep moving forward.」

736:t_1:298.en:
$$號$$
「The decisive battle with the $$御使い$$ and stopping the great collapse of the universe... It's a fight over whether we advance into a new era or lose everything.」

736:t_1:299.en:
$$甲児$$
「That's why... we can't lose. I still don't know what to do about it, but in spirit, at least...」

736:t_1:300.en:
$$竜馬$$
「That's all you need, $$甲児$$. ...Let's show those $$御使い$$ bastards.」

736:t_1:301.en:
$$竜馬$$
「What our... what humanity's fight for its life is really like.」

736:t_1:303.en:
$$チコ$$
「Hey, hey, $$ノリコ$$, $$カズミ$$, what are you two going to do once the fighting is over?」

736:t_1:304.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「After the $$時獄戦役$$ was over, I was planning to travel through space with the $$フロンティア船団$$, but... what should I do...」

736:t_1:305.en:
$$カズミ$$
「They'll probably be colonizing the $$バジュラ$$ homeworld, so it won't really be a journey.」

736:t_1:306.en:
$$シモン$$
「Then why don't you come with us?」

736:t_1:307.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Go...? To the $$新世界大陸$$?」

736:t_1:308.en:
$$シモン$$
「No, not there. A journey out into the vast universe.」

736:t_1:309.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Is $$大グレン団$$ setting off into space?」

736:t_1:310.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「From what $$ロージェノム$$ told me, with the $$アンチスパイラル$$ defeated, all kinds of spiral life forms have started expanding into space again.」

736:t_1:311.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「They're the people who lent us a hand in the fight against the space monsters, too.」

736:t_1:312.en:
$$ギミー$$
「We're going to visit those people and form the $$超グレン団$$, active all across the universe!」

736:t_1:313.en:
$$ダリー$$
「...Well, that's $$ギミー$$'s dream, but I'd like to meet people from stars I don't know, too.」

736:t_1:314.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「So it's the start of a new adventure with space as the stage.」

736:t_1:316.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Yes, Big Sis! Let's ask to join in too!」

736:t_1:319.en:
$$ニア$$
「We don't mind, but is that really all right with you, $$ノノ$$?」

736:t_1:320.en:
$$ノノ$$
「...Once Earth is at peace, there won't be any place for $$ノノ$$ anymore...」

736:t_1:321.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Can't be helped... In that case, I have no choice but to go too.」

736:t_1:323.en:
$$ラルク$$
「It irks me to hear you say you have no place to belong.」

736:t_1:325.en:
$$ラルク$$
「It isn't right for someone running away from Earth to ride along with $$大グレン団$$, which sets out with hope.」

超グレン団.evidence: Gimmy's coined name for a new team (超 + グレン団); glossary has グレン団 = Team Gurren and 大グレン団 = Team Dai-Gurren; not in the sheet.
